kyubu: candidate (kyubu)

symbols.comment:
kyubu: candidate (kyubu)

thread: accept, read the client's packet id (17) and version, print it, refuse full or wrong-version clients, send the join, build a cube::Creature and a cube::Connection, start its receive loop. A version other than 3 (compare at 0x42554E) gets a bare 3, not 17 (static, see probe:protocol-version)

symbols.comment:
kyubu: candidate (kyubu)
evidence: xref:server_accept_loop; manual:cmp dword [ebp-0x1BC],3; je; probe:server-level-sites
in server_accept_loop: the client's version against 3. The 3 is an imm8 (83 BD 44 FE FF FF 03): 0x4B4C0001 does not fit, so D7's byte patch is impossible here; 8.3 needs a mid hook. A wrong version gets the bare reply below.
symbols.name: Net::acceptVersionSite

symbols.comment:
kyubu: candidate (kyubu)
evidence: xref:server_accept_loop; manual:mov dword [ebp-0x198],3, send, Sleep 500, close; probe:server-level-sites
the refusal of a wrong version: sends a 4-byte 3 (imm32 at 0x425565), waits 500 ms, closes. Vanilla never sends the 17 the client's version text belongs to; the mod (task 8.3) patches it to 17 and sends 8 bytes, so probes trace 0x42556E.
symbols.name: Net::acceptWrongVersionReplySite

symbols.comment:
kyubu: candidate (kyubu)
evidence: xref:server_accept_loop; manual:je target at 0x425555: the join reply
in server_accept_loop: the join. Reached when the client's version equals 3 (task 8.3: the mod's hook at 0x42554E turns the mod's version into 3 and vanilla's 3 into 0, so only a modded client gets here on a modded server). Sends the 4-byte 0x10 reply.

thread: accept, read the client's packet id (17) and version, print it, refuse full or wrong-version clients, send the join, build a cube::Creature and a cube::Connection, start its receive loop. A version other than 3 (compare at 0x42575E) gets a bare 3, not 17 (static, see probe:protocol-version)

kyubu: candidate (kyubu)

in server_accept_loop: the client's version against 3. The 3 is an imm8 (83 BD 44 FE FF FF 03): 0x4B4C0001 does not fit, so D7's byte patch is impossible here; 8.3 needs a mid hook. A wrong version gets the bare reply below.
symbols.name: Net::acceptVersionSite

symbols.comment:

evidence: xref:server_accept_loop; manual:mov dword [ebp-0x198],3, send, Sleep 500, close; correlated:server-0x51D2CE9B:Net::acceptWrongVersionReplySite
the refusal of a wrong version: sends a 4-byte 3 (imm32 at 0x425775), waits 500 ms, closes. Vanilla never sends the 17 the client's version text belongs to; the mod (task 8.3) patches it to 17 and sends 8 bytes, so probes trace 0x42577E.
symbols.name: Net::acceptWrongVersionReplySite

symbols.comment:
